description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature attacks you while you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] to them, you share a language with that creature, and that creature is within range of your limited telepathy.

The very thoughts of your enemies give them away. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being off-guard.
